# Governance Tuple Reference Implementation

> Anonymized, MIT-licensed, standalone reference implementation for the paper
> "The Governance Tuple: An Atomic Record for Auditable Agentic AI Decision-Making"

## Overview
This repository provides a stdlib-only Python implementation of the Governance
Tuple framework, enabling peer reviewers to verify the paper's implementation
claims without accessing the private production codebase.

## Quick Start
```bash
python verify_chain.py sample_governance_log.jsonl
python -m pytest tests/ -v
```

## Modules

### reference_impl/delegation_token.py
Delegation Capability Token (DCT) with HMAC-SHA256 signing.
- Classes: DelegationCapabilityToken, TokenBinding, ResourceSelector, Caveat, DelegationTokenManager
- Key methods: create_token, verify_signature, is_expired, validate_binding, to_env_string, from_env_string
- Error codes: IDP_E_DCT_VIOLATION, IDP_E_TOKEN_EXPIRED, IDP_E_TOKEN_INVALID, IDP_E_BINDING_MISMATCH, IDP_E_LATERAL_AUTH, IDP_E_DECISION_AUTH

### reference_impl/delegation_context.py
Delegation Context (DCTX) with state machine and trust-decay depth model.
- Classes: DelegationContext, DelegationContextManager, DelegationBudget
- Key methods: compute_dynamic_depth, create_child, can_subdelegate, transition, is_terminal, is_active, create_root, get_context, get_by_intent, get_chain
- Constants: DEFAULT_MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=3, DEFAULT_MAX_REPLANS=2
- Trust-decay: delta_effective = min(delta_max, floor(tau/tau_o)) where tau_LOW=0.15, tau_MEDIUM=0.20, tau_HIGH=0.25, tau_CRITICAL=0.40
- Error codes: IDP_E_DEPTH_EXCEEDED, IDP_E_INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION, IDP_E_REPLAN_LIMIT, IDP_E_CAPABILITY_ESCALATION, IDP_E_TRUST_DEPTH_EXCEEDED

### reference_impl/governance_bus.py
Append-only, hash-chained governance audit log.
- Classes: GovernanceBus, GovernanceEntry
- Key methods: append, _append_sync, verify_chain, compute_entry_hash, _get_last_entry_hash, enforce_retention, query_by_intent, query_by_task, query_by_entry_id
- Constants: DEFAULT_RETENTION_DAYS=180, ROTATION_SIZE_BYTES=10MB, DEFAULT_GOVERNANCE_DIR=Path("governance_logs")
- Error codes: IDP_E_AUDIT_INCOMPLETE, IDP_E_AUDIT_IMMUTABLE, IDP_E_AMENDMENT_TARGET_MISSING, IDP_E_VERIFICATION_REF_INVALID, IDP_E_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, IDP_E_CHAIN_BROKEN

### reference_impl/adapter_receipt.py
Per-inference governance proof with compliance crosswalk.
- Classes: AdapterReceipt
- Key methods: generate, verify, save

### reference_impl/basen_tuple.py
Universal governance tuple for any tool call.
- Classes: BaseNTuple
- Key methods: to_dict, to_json, content_hash, sign_tuple, verify_tuple_signature

## Tuple Types
- CONTRACT: Governing agreement (allowed/denied ops, risk tier)
- DCT: Delegation Capability Token (HMAC-SHA256 signed authorization)
- DCTX: Delegation Context (chain depth, state machine, budget)
- EVIDENCE: Execution artifact (result hash, duration)
- ATTEST: Verification result (PASS/FAIL, links to EVIDENCE)

## DCTX State Machine
PROPOSED -> ISSUED -> RUNNING -> EVIDENCE_READY -> VERIFIED
Also: EVIDENCE_READY -> REPLANNED -> PROPOSED (with replan limit)
Also: ISSUED/RUNNING/REPLANNED -> FAILED
Terminal: VERIFIED, FAILED

## Feature Flag
ENABLE_IDP env var (default: true). Fail-closed: governance validation is mandatory.

## Requirements
- Python 3.11+
- No external dependencies (stdlib only)
- pytest for tests (optional)
